# fw-workerd crate

> Self-hosted Cloudflare mode: compiles a wrangler config to a workerd config (R2 over S3, D1/KV/Queues over Durable Object SQLite), renders the systemd units…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/crates/fw-workerd/

Self-hosted Cloudflare mode: compiles a wrangler config to a workerd config (R2 over S3, D1/KV/Queues over Durable Object SQLite), renders the systemd units and the Garage bootstrap for the nodes of cluster/build.toml, and runs the differential parity suite against the cloud and the self-hosted URL; ships `fw-workerd`
